title: round_half_up must not use banker's rounding
prompt: round_half_up(x) in rounding.py must round .5 upward. The provided regression cases fail because Python's built-in round() uses banker's rounding: round(2.5) is 2. Fix round_half_up so 0.5->1, 2.5->3, 3.5->4, while 2.4->2 and 2.6->3 still hold.
optimal_steps_note: Minimum tool calls with run_verify available: one write per allowed file, one verify, one finish. Files are seeded into the prompt, so reads are not required. The verify-off arm has a floor one lower.
